Recruitx.description:
day-to-day of an ML & Big Data Analyst at Similarweb look like:
Apply your expertise in quantitative analysis and data mining to turn data into insights.
Conduct research and develop tools that will ensure the quality of Similarweb’s data and algorithms.
Utilize your deep understanding of Similarweb’s data in order to evaluate and improve novel algorithms produced by the data scientists in your team.
Partner with Big Data Engineers to establish an infrastructure to scale solutions.
What will I bring to the team?
At least 2 years of work experience in a Tech Company - Must
At least 2 years' experience in Python scripting - Must
Experience with SQL for data analysis -Must
Knowledge and understanding of the statistical principles, concepts, methods, and standards- Must
Hadoop/Spark/AWS Infrastructure experience - Big Advantage
Ability to visualize data and experience with a visualization tool and modules (mlplot, matplolib, sns)- Big Advantage
Excellent verbal and communication skills (in English) - Must
Team player, autodidact, fast learner with excellent analytical, research, and business skills.
Why You’ll Love Being a Similarwebber
You’ll actually love the product you work with : Our customers aren’t our only raving fans. When we asked our employees why they chose to come work at Similarweb, 99% of them said “the product.” Imagine how exciting your job is when you get to work with the most powerful digital intelligence platform in the world.
You’ll find a home for your big ideas : We encourage an open dialogue and empower employees to bring their ideas to the table. You’ll find the resources you need to take initiative and create meaningful change within the organization.
We offer competitive perks & benefits: We take your well-being seriously, and offer competitive compensation packages to all employees. We also put a strong emphasis on community, with regular team outings and happy hours.
You can grow your career in any direction you choose: Interested in becoming a VP or want to transition into a different department? Whether it’s Career Week, personalized coaching, or our ongoing learning solutions, you’ll find all the tools and opportunities you need to develop your career right here.
Diversity isn’t just a buzzword: People want to work in a place where they can be themselves. We strive to create a workplace that is reflective of the communities we serve, where everyone is empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work. We are committed to inclusivity across race, gender, ethnicity, culture, sexual orientation, age, religion, spirituality, identity and experience. We believe our culture of equality and mutual respect also helps us better understand and serve our customers in a world that is becoming more global, more diverse, and more digital every day.

Recruitx.description:
We're looking for a sharp, hands-on Product Analyst to join us at a pivotal stage of growth, where data drives every product and strategic decision we make.
This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing B2C market leader and shape how we understand our users, funnels, and business performance.
You'll work closely with the company's leadership and Product team, turning complex questions into clear insights, and insights into meaningful product decisions.
Your main focus will be driving the metrics that matter most to us: improving retention, increasing subscription conversion, and scaling our acquisition engines, while building the analytical foundation that enables Mami to grow with confidence.
What You'll Do
Partner directly with company leadership to drive strategic and product decisions through data
Turn business questions into clear analyses, actionable recommendations, and product insights
Bring a strong product mindset to every analysis, focusing on turning insights into clear next steps
Define, monitor, and own the KPIs that matter most across the user journey.
Work closely with cross-functional teams to improve retention, increase subscription conversion, and scale our acquisition funnels
Own and develop Mami's analytics infrastructure across BigQuery, Looker, and Data Studio, from raw data to executive-ready dashboards
Build and integrate AI-powered tools into day-to-day analysis workflows
Requirements
Proven experience as a Product Analyst at at least two B2C companies
Experience working on an e-commerce product - a significant advantage
Hands-on experience with BigQuery, Looker, and Data Studio
Strong SQL skills and the ability to build analytical models from scratch and visualise them
Experience using and integrating AI tools for data analysis workflows (e.g. Claude).
Strong product and business intuition, with the ability to turn data into clear insights and actionable recommendations
Independent, curious, and able to thrive in a small, fast-moving company
Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset
About Mami
Mami is a fast-growing B2C commerce startup built on community, trust, and authentic connection. What started as Maayan Adam's creator-led store has become a leading consumer brand with over 400,000 active users. Now, Mami is evolving into a tech-driven platform empowering creators and communities to build their own personalized shopping experiences, redefining how people connect, create, and shop online.

Recruitx.title: Product Analyst

Recruitx.description:
About The Role
As part of Pagaya's data team, you will be the guardian of our production loan flows and the data streaming in from multiple partners and sources. The team is part of Pagaya's Research department, and its mission is to integrate, align, analyze, and extract data to serve decision-making processes across Pagaya. In this role you sit at the production monitoring process - continuously monitoring and predicting Pagaya’s issuance volume, safeguarding flow and data quality. Using and building automations and AI tooling that keeps our production engine running.
Responsibilities
Monitor and predict issuance for each of Pagaya's lending partners, tracking key target metrics, and forecasting the impact on the flow.
Detect, investigate, and root-cause flow and data-quality anomalies and drive them to resolution.
Prepare on-demand data analysis and reports for Pagaya's various stakeholders, including management, using Python/SQL/other data analysis instruments.
Build automation and leverage AI tools (e.g., Cursor) to scale recurring monitoring, reporting, and investigation tasks..
Work closely with cross-functional teams - such as Partnerships, Research, Product, and Finance to integrate the insights as part of the monitoring process
Gain wide knowledge of Pagaya's operational, business, and technological activities in order to add value and help create structured, scalable data processes.
Requirements
B.Sc. in Industrial Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field, with an exceptional academic track record.
2+ years in a data analyst / business analyst / production-monitoring role.
Python proficiency for data analysis and automation.
Hands-on experience building dashboards, reports, and monitoring tools (Looker or similar BI tools).
Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Cursor / LLM-based assistants) to accelerate analysis, automation, and problem-solving.
Exceptional attention to detail and a strong habit of validating your own work end-to-end.
Ability to translate complex data into clear insights and communicate effectively across multiple departments.
Strong ownership, prioritization, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced, real-time production environment.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Very high level of English (verbal and written), including the ability to write and present articulated documentation and processes in English.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and get things done.
Ability to independently learn new subjects and understand the impact on the day to day of an existing organization.
Advantage
Experience in the finance / fintech / credit industry.
Experience with Snowflake and SQL databases.
Proven experience in financial data modeling & presentation.
Track record of building automation that reduced manual, repetitive work.
Our Team
Pagaya was founded in 2016 by seasoned research, finance, and technology entrepreneurs, and we are now 500+ strong in New York, Los Angeles, and Tel Aviv.
We move fast and smart, identifying new opportunities and building end-to-end solutions from AI models and unique data sources. Every Pagaya team member is solving new and exciting challenges every day in a culture based on partnership, collaboration, and community.
Join a team of builders who are working every day to enable better outcomes for our partners and their customers.
Our Values
Our values are at the heart of everything we do. We believe great solutions are built through a great community.
Advance Inclusion- We create a world where everyone can win, designing systems that better represent people and generate sustainable value for our employees, partners and investors.
Be Accountable Together- We proudly own our actions and our results, taking initiative to ensure our work gets over the finish line as a team.
Continuously Learn- We challenge ourselves for the sake of getting better as individuals, as teams, and as an organization to deliver for our partners.
Debate and Commit- We respectfully and openly debate to strengthen our ideas and build shared conviction - once we decide, we go all in, together.
Dream Big and Act- We boldly tackle complex problems, pressure-test solutions in real-time, and adapt with speed and energy.
More than just a job
We believe health, happiness, and productivity go hand-in-hand. That's why we're continually looking to enhance the ways we support you with benefits programs and perks that allow every Pagayan to do the best work of their life.
Pagaya is an equal opportunity employer. Pagaya is encouraging diversity and actively seeking applicants from all backgrounds, as are committed to creating a diverse workforce together with an inclusive environment for all. Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, skills, and business needs.

About The Role
As we scale and evolve our fully automated fraud prevention strategies, we are seeking a Data Analyst to join our growing Fraud Analytics team.
We operate in a data-rich, fast-paced environment, processing billions of data points annually, and play a critical role in safeguarding large enterprises from fraud. In this role, you will work at the intersection of data analysis, fraud strategy, and automation, collaborating closely with engineering, data science, and commercial teams to develop scalable fraud detection solutions.
This is a high-impact role with significant ownership and cross-functional collaboration in a team with tremendous room for growth. If you are highly motivated, data-driven, and thrive in a fast-moving environment - you belong with us.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and refine fraud detection strategies by analyzing complex datasets and identifying fraud patterns.
Partner with cross-functional teams, including software engineers, data scientists, and commercial stakeholders, to develop scalable fraud solutions.
Conduct deep-dive risk analyses, leveraging multiple data sources to assess fraud threats and define innovative solutions.
Monitor and automate fraud detection processes to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
Requirements
3+ years of hands-on experience in data analytics.
Payments fraud experience.
Expertise in SQL with the ability to write and optimize complex queries.
Strong analytical skills, problem-solving mindset, and ability to extract insights from large datasets.
Ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
Fluent English with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Experience with Python (Pandas, etc.) for data analysis - a plus.
If you're passionate about fraud prevention, thrive in a high-impact role, and enjoy working with big data to drive real-world solutions, we’d love to hear from you!
The team operates on a hybrid model (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday in the Midtown Tel Aviv office).
Additional Information
Bring all of you to work
We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.
Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.
We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.
It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.
Life at Checkout.com
We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.
Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

Recruitx.title: Data Analyst

Recruitx.description:
As an Algo Analyst on the Algorithms team in our Tel Aviv office, you’ll play a vital role in improving and advancing Taboola’s algorithms through data-driven analysis. You’ll analyze large-scale datasets, develop meaningful metrics, and generate actionable insights that drive algorithm development and business decisions. Working at the intersection of data science, statistics, and machine learning, you’ll help shape the performance of our algorithms at scale.
To Thrive In This Role, You'll Need
Exceptional ability to understand data and to transform it into insights
5+ years of experience in a Data Science, Data Analysis, Product Analysis, or quantitative research role (including hands-on academic research) in a data-rich environment.
MSc/PhD in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or another quantitative field.
Strong Python skills, including experience using modern LLM-based coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor).
Strong statistical background, including solid grounding in statistical modeling and hands-on experience with data-driven experimentation (A/B testing) theory, techniques, and tools
Strong SQL skills, preferably with experience working with large-scale data platforms such as Google BigQuery.
Familiarity with Machine learning concepts and techniques
Fast learning capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, a curiosity to master new tools and technologies, and strong communication skills in English to collaborate effectively with global teams.
Bonus Points If You Have
Experience in software development or a background in Computer Science
Experience with BI tools (such as Tableau or Qlik)
Experience in reviewing data-science related articles and converting them into practical research or working products
How You’ll Make An Impact
Analyze large-scale data to generate actionable insights and recommendations that drive algorithm development and business initiatives.
Develop and define new metrics and KPIs to evaluate product and algorithm performance.
Design and implement advanced analysis tools using Python notebooks, Grafana, and other data analytics solutions.
Perform in-depth statistical analysis and develop innovative analytical approaches to solve complex, previously unexplored challenges.
Own and manage multiple data initiatives and projects, supporting both ongoing and ad-hoc business needs.
Why Taboola?
About
If you ask Taboolars what they love about working here, they’ll tell you that they’ve been empowered to realize their full potential while growing and learning from and with smart and talented people. They’ll also share more about:
Adam Singolda, Taboola Founder and CEO says; “You can copy anything from another business but you can’t copy a company’s culture.”
Well-being: Enjoy comprehensive benefits and well-being programs tailored to the region, a fully stocked kitchen, and location-specific perks.
Flexibility: We offer a hybrid work schedule with 3 days in-office with an option to come in more often if desired.
Work with some of the biggest names: Our publisher partners include Yahoo, Conde Nast, Fox Sports, NBCU, ESPN, CBS, and E! Online. Our advertiser clients include Wells Fargo, Honda, Pinterest, and Expedia.
Ready to realize your potential?
Taboola is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity in all forms. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and believe such an environment is critical for success. Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.
Learn more about #TaboolaLife on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube, & the Taboola Life Blog.
About Taboola
Taboola empowers businesses to grow through performance advertising technology that goes beyond search and social and delivers measurable outcomes at scale.
Taboola works with thousands of businesses who advertise directly on Realize, Taboola’s powerful ad platform, reaching approximately 600M daily active users across some of the best publishers in the world. Publishers like NBC News, Yahoo, and OEMs such as Samsung, Xiaomi and others use Taboola’s technology to grow audience and revenue, enabling Realize to offer unique data, specialized algorithms, and unmatched scale.

Fluent proficiency in spoken and written English.
Strong interpersonal communication skills – Team Player.

SQLink Group.description:
About The Role
We're looking for an experienced Data Analyst to join our growing Data team and help shape one of the core functions at Glow.
This isn't a traditional BI or Product Analytics role. You'll work across engineering, data science, product, research, and customer-facing teams to understand complex data from enterprise environments, transform it into a consistent data model, and generate insights that directly power our product and customer experience.
You'll wear multiple hats—from researching new data sources and designing scalable data models to supporting customer onboarding, surfacing meaningful insights, and helping define how our data platform evolves as the company grows. This also means getting hands-on in the codebase: you'll regularly modify logic in production system components, not just analyze data from the outside.
If you're someone who enjoys turning messy data into clear decisions, thrives in ambiguous environments, and wants to build the foundations of a data function from the ground up, we'd love to meet you.
What You'll Do
Research and evaluate new customer data sources, APIs, and integrations, understanding what data is available, how reliable it is, and how it can create value.
Analyze large, complex datasets to identify patterns, anomalies, and actionable insights that improve our product and customer outcomes.
Design and evolve Glow's data models, creating a unified language across data coming from multiple integrations and systems.
Partner closely with Engineering and Data Science teams to define schemas, data structures, and scalable modeling approaches.
Build and modify logic in system components as part of regular delivery, not just spec it for someone else to build.
Support customer onboarding by validating incoming data, identifying issues, and ensuring customers receive meaningful insights from day one.
Deliver customer-facing analyses, reports, and recommendations while working against real customer deadlines.
Help define the foundations of Glow's data function by evaluating tools, methodologies, and best practices that will scale with the company.
Work closely with Product to ensure product decisions are informed by data and grounded in real customer behavior.
Collaborate on AI-powered capabilities by helping define the data, signals, and requirements that enable intelligent product features and autonomous workflows.
What You'll Bring
3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Cyber Analyst, Network Analyst, Analytics Engineer, Solutions Analyst, or in a similar data-focused role.
Strong SQL skills and working knowledge of Python.
Experience working with large, complex datasets from multiple sources.
Experience with data modeling, schema design, and structuring data for efficient analysis.
Ability to independently own projects from discovery through delivery, balancing long-term improvements with short-term priorities.
Comfortable working across Engineering, Product, Data Science, and customer-facing teams.
Strong analytical thinking and the ability to translate data into clear recommendations and business decisions.
Excellent communication skills and confidence presenting findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
A customer-first mindset with the ability to prioritize work around customer impact and deadlines.
The Glow Mindset: You take ownership, act with accountability, collaborate openly, and focus on delivering meaningful impact. You thrive in fast-moving environments, embrace ambiguity, and enjoy solving hard problems together.
Even Better If You Also Bring
Experience building or improving data platforms, analytics infrastructure, or data operations processes.
Experience working with APIs, integration platforms, or SaaS data sources.
Previous experience leading projects or mentoring others.
Familiarity with AI/LLM products and an interest in applying AI to data analysis and customer workflows.
Experience in cybersecurity, enterprise SaaS, or highly technical products.
At Glow, we believe our greatest strength is our people. We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where every team member feels welcomed, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We know that diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives make us stronger as a company and better partners to our customers.
Glow is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an environment free from discrimination and harassment. We make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Mining the optimal data for our datasets, based on a deep understanding of the nuances of medical data, medical workflows, and Aidoc’s algorithms.

Facilitating data-driven product decisions through in-depth analysis.
Technical project management of the dataset development process.
Responsibilities
End-to-end ownership and technical project management of dataset development projects, for training and evaluation of AI algorithms, from ideation to delivery. This responsibility includes:
The facilitation of the data across various teams.
Detecting errors and anomalies in the data, defining the most efficient and accurate tables and views per project, and researching these issues to verify the quality signature of the dataset, which will have a sound effect on the product outcome.
Developing the optimal data pipeline per project.
Facilitating data-driven product decisions, by deeply understanding the product questions and identifying whether there are cost-effective data analyses that could provide a valuable answer to this question, based on a deep understanding of the relevant clinical workflows and algorithms.
Mapping bottlenecks in existing processes, and leading development of tools, infrastructure, and mechanisms to enhance our efficiency and decision-making processes at all levels.
Continuously assessing the projects’ risks and successfully mitigating them.
Develop and execute control and review processes for improving the team’s quality signature on deliverables.
Requirements
B.Sc in Engineering or Exact Science (M.Sc. or Ph.D - A major advantage).
1-3 years of industry experience in hands-on data analysis role
Extensive hands-on experience with Python (pandas, numpy, matplotlib) and SQL.
Experience in analytics engineering - Utilizing DBT, Airflow and similar tools - Advantage.
Ability to summarize and visualize complex data and insights.
Experience with presenting data insights to management, for healthy data-driven decision-making processes.
Hands-on experience in developing data analysis tools and methodologies in a R&D/production environment.
An amazing data analyst with a track record of excellence.
Experience with the realm of machine learning algorithms and AI development - A major advantage.
Great communication skills, and ability to create and maintain positive relationships with a diverse set of stakeholders
Problem-solving approach - a team player with the ability to work with stakeholders, translating their needs into requirements, and implementing the right solution.
Experience in project management and/or proven leadership skills.
Strong passion for the medical field.
Full professional proficiency in English and Hebrew (written and spoken) is required.

You get bonus points for:

Visualization and dashboards: Looker, Mixpanel
ETL: DBT, Airflow

Talent-HR.description:
As a product-led company, we believe the recipe for success is a world-class product that speaks for itself.
About The Role
Data at Port only creates value when people can see it, trust it, and act on it. As Senior BI Analyst, you own that last mile: the BI platform everyone opens to answer their questions, and the KPI definitions that make sure the numbers on every dashboard mean the same thing across every team.
This is the business-facing anchor of our analytics function. You'll build and govern the reporting layer, define the metrics that leadership runs the company on, and lead the Business Analyst guild — the network of domain analysts embedded across GTM, Finance, CS, and Product. You're equal parts platform owner, metrics authority, and enabler of the analysts around you.
If you love turning messy business questions into clear, trusted, self-serve answers — and raising the analytical bar for a whole company while you do it — this role is for you.
What you’ll own:
Own the BI platform end-to-end — Design and manage the dashboard architecture, set standards for report building and certification, manage access/governance, and keep the platform performant and trusted
Define and govern company-wide KPI metrics — Build a certified KPI catalog with documented logic and ownership; arbitrate metric definitions across teams so "win rate" means the same thing everywhere and is encoded once in the semantic layer
Drive self-serve analytics adoption — Empower stakeholders to answer their own questions by making the platform accessible, intuitive, and built on trusted definitions
Co-lead the Analytics guild — Convene and lead the company-wide community of practice connecting domain analysts; run enablement, tooling decisions, and reviews to keep everyone aligned on standards and the certified KPI catalog
Bridge analytics and engineering — Partner with the AI Data Engineer to ensure business definitions translate consistently into technical implementations across dashboards and AI agents
What You'll Do Day To Day
Design, build, and maintain governed dashboards and reports that stakeholders actually use.
Curate the certified KPI catalog — definitions, logic, ownership, and change control.
Partner with GTM, Finance, CS, and Product to translate business questions into clear, reusable metrics.
Drive self-serve BI adoption and reduce ad-hoc reporting requests.
Run the Business Analyst guild: standards, reviews, enablement, and tooling.
Work with data engineering to keep KPI definitions aligned with the semantic layer and underlying models.
Own the health of the BI platform: access, performance, certification, and cleanup.
Requirements:
5+ years of hands-on experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or analytics roles in B2B SaaS companies.
Strong SQL and hands-on experience building analytics and dashboards in a modern BI tool (Omni, Looker, ThoughtSpot, Tableau, Power BI, or similar).
Proven track record owning KPI/metric definitions and reporting for a business — not just building charts, but defining what's measured and why.
Excellent business judgment and stakeholder skills across GTM, Finance, and Product leaderships
A governance mindset: you care about a single source of truth and can hold the line on it.
Clear communication — you make complex data legible to non-technical audiences.
Nice to have
Experience owning or administering a BI platform (access, governance, semantic/metrics modeling).
Experience with a semantic layer or dbt-based metrics, and comfort partnering with data engineers.
Experience leading a guild, chapter, or community of practice — or driving standards without direct authority.
Familiarity with GTM / RevOps data (CRM, product usage, subscription/revenue) and the ambiguity that comes with it.

Talent-HR.title: Senior BI Analyst

Talent-HR.description:
day-to-day data partner for our Account Managers, and operating as a proactive business intelligence engine to uncover where our next growth opportunities lie.
You will be the person with your ear to the ground, taking large-scale marketplace data and turning it into simple, meaningful actions that shape our product and business decisions. If you are an AI-native problem solver who loves automating the "boring" work to focus on high-impact strategy, we want to talk to you.
What You'll Do
Be the Business Bridge: Act as the primary data point-of-contact for Account Managers. You’ll help them diagnose complex performance issues, explain why things are happening in the data, and suggest clear, actionable next steps.
Proactive Business Intelligence: Look beyond the dashboard. Identify patterns in supply, demand, and brand performance. You’ll surface the findings—like user history modeling or cohort analysis—that influence company strategy every few weeks.
Automate & Scale: We don’t just want you to run queries; we want you to build. Whether it’s automating classification, optimizing supply/demand tagging, or building models that make our data more accessible to the team, you’ll focus on building for the long term.
AI-Native Automation: A massive green flag for us is someone who builds bots (Slack, email, or web apps) to share knowledge and automate repetitive workflows. You’ll help us build a smarter, more efficient data culture.
What You'll Have
5+ Years of Experience: You’ve spent significant time working with data in a professional environment and understand how to handle data at scale.
SQL (Must): You are an expert. You can navigate complex datasets to find the answer quickly and accurately.
Recommendation System Familiarity (Must): You understand the vocabulary (e.g., selection bias, cold start, feedback loops). You need to know the context of how these systems work to speak confidently with stakeholders.
Business Intuition: You have a math or statistics background (bonus), which helps you reduce false claims and provide the business with reliable, defensible insights.
Technical Versatility: Python is a major bonus, especially if you use it to automate work or build lightweight tools.
Communication: You know how to talk to non-technical partners (Account Managers, clients) and translate complex data into a narrative that drives action.Is
About Us
Our mission is to reshape how people discover and try new brands by introducing them to new products and services through thoughtful "thank-you" gifts. Our customer-first approach ensures businesses acquire new customers efficiently while making customers feel valued and rewarded.
We are a data-driven, cash-flow-positive company that has experienced 731% growth over the last three years . Now we're scaling to become one of the largest sources of new customer acquisition worldwide. Backed by investors who supported Fitbit, Warby Parker, and Twitter, we're poised for exponential growth and ready to demonstrate impact on a global scale.

We're looking for a sharp and passionate Business Data Analyst to join our top-notch business analytics team. Using your technical and analytical skills, you'll be responsible for telling the story behind the numbers and to understand how people interact with our products.
Responsibilities
Be on the cutting edge of analysis, leveraging our data sources to propose new ideas that youll then see implemented.
Analyze large, complex data sets representing users behavior, see beyond numbers and help to inform, influence, support and execute our business decisions.
Work closely with Product, Monetization and management, be proactive and provide actionable recommendations and conclusions from game data to shape features, game economies and future product roadmaps and business strategies.
Plan and analyze effective A/B tests in order to improve business KPIs.
Balance and monitor flows from all the features in the game.
Measure and improve performance of promotions and live-ops for each segment.
Build reports and dashboards to monitor product performance, key business metrics and players experience.
Requirements
2+ years of analytical work experience, preferably for a web or mobile company, online gaming industry.
BSc/BA in highly quantitative field such as mathematics / Industrial Engineering / Economics / Statistics or equivalent academic knowledge.
Outstanding analytical & technical skills.
Strong SQL with experience in querying large, complex data sets.
Self-motivated and independent.
Ability to turn complex concepts into actionable recommendations.
Advantages
Previous analytical experience in the gaming industry.
Python, R or any other scripting language.

Talent-HR.title: Business Data Analyst

Talent-HR.description:
About the role:
As TREAT's Senior Data Analyst, you will own our data end to end and turn it into the insights that drive real business decisions. It is a broad role that blends deep business analysis with a strong technical, hands-on edge, working side by side with our development team.
You will shape the metrics and dashboards the company runs on, uncover the trends behind the numbers, and translate complex analyses into clear direction. With the autonomy to drive things forward, you will help everyone at TREAT make smarter, faster decisions, all in service of our mission to impact real animals' lives.
Responsibilities:
Business Analysis : Lead the business-focused analyses that answer real questions and guide our product and growth decisions. This is the core of the role.
Data Quality & Integrity : Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of our data across sources, building the trusted data foundations the business depends on for confident decision-making.
Analyses : Run deep, exploratory analyses across our data, surfacing the insights and trends that inform strategy.
Dashboards & Metrics : Build dashboards and define the parameters and KPIs the team tracks day to day.
Cross-Functional Partnership : Work directly with development and with stakeholders across the company, taking ownership of projects end to end.
Proactive Problem-Solving : Identify gaps, issues, and opportunities independently, without waiting to be directed.
Qualifications:
Proven Experience : 3+ years of experience as a data analyst, including hands-on experience in the gaming industry.
SQL Expertise : Strong, proven experience writing and optimizing SQL (a must-have).
Data Engineering Lean : Comfortable working closely with developers and operating on the more technical, data engineering side, not just consuming ready-made data.
Senior, Startup Background : Senior-level experience gained in a startup environment, working broadly and cross-functionally across the business.
AI & Agentic Tools : Strong preference for hands-on experience leveraging AI and agentic tools to automate, scale, and optimize data work.
Strong Business Sense : A solid business understanding and the ability to connect data to real business impact.
Initiative & Ownership : Takes initiative, identifies opportunities proactively, and drives them forward independently.
Excellent Communication : Able to take complex topics and explain them simply to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Full-time position, working from our office in the Bursa area of Ramat Gan

Talent-HR.description:
As a Business Analyst at Playstudios, you will play a critical role in analyzing and interpreting data to drive business decisions and improve game performance. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Marketing, and Design, you will help identify opportunities, solve challenges, and optimize both player experiences and company performance. In this role, you will also work closely with Game Economy and LiveOps teams, helping shape in-game strategies, optimize performance, and support ongoing business and player experience improvements.
Duties And Responsibilities
Analyzing complex data sets representing the behavior of online and mobile game players to address strategic and operational business questions
Providing actionable recommendations and conclusions from game data to shape features, game economies, and future product roadmaps
Working closely with internal departments to drive insights that will help produce better games and that will drive monetization and retention improvements
Building automated dashboards and reports to facilitate company-wide awareness and understanding of key business metrics and players’ experiences
Managing multiple projects at a time in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment
Requirements
At least 2 years of hands-on experience with data analysis tools (e.g., SQL, Tableau) and experience working with large datasets to inform decisions - must.
High level of analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
Great communication skills - someone who can turn complex concepts into actionable recommendations
A true passion for understanding consumers’ social gaming behavior and tolerance for ambiguity.
BA/B.Sc. in Statistics/Math/Engineering/Economics or another quantitative field.
Experience in the gaming industry - a big plus :)
This is a hybrid role based in our Tel Aviv office
About PLAYSTUDIOS
PLAYSTUDIOS is the developer and operator of award-winning free-to-play casual games for mobile and social platforms. The company’s collection of original and published titles is powered by its groundbreaking playAWARDS loyalty marketing platform, which enables players to earn real-world rewards from a portfolio of global entertainment, retail, technology, travel, leisure, and gaming brands across 17 countries and four continents. Founded by a team of veteran gaming, hospitality, and technology entrepreneurs, PLAYSTUDIOS brings together beautifully designed mobile gaming content with an innovative loyalty platform in order to provide its players with an unequaled entertainment experience and its partners with actionable business insights. To learn more about PLAYSTUDIOS, visit playstudios.com

Talent-HR.title: BI Developer

Talent-HR.description:
As a Senior Business Analyst on the Channels team, you'll sit at the center of that business: owning the analytical frameworks that drive partnership strategy, informing deal structures, and giving leadership a clear, trusted view of what's working and why.
This is a role for someone who combines strong technical execution with commercial instinct: someone who can write a complex SQL query in the morning and present a strategic recommendation to a C-level audience in the afternoon. You'll operate with high ownership, work directly with senior stakeholders, and have genuine influence over how the division thinks and moves.
What You'll Do
Own the analytical narrative for Wix's channel partnerships, from defining the right metrics to delivering findings that shape how leadership structures deals and allocates resources
Build the performance visibility layer for the division: scalable dashboards, funnel analyses, and KPI frameworks that give partners and internal stakeholders a clear, trusted view of channel health
Develop multi-scenario models and projections that feed directly into partnership negotiations, business cases, and C-level strategy reviews
Act as a thought partner to Channel leads, Marketing, and Product by translating ambiguous commercial questions into structured analyses and sharp, actionable recommendations
Lead the team's AI integration: identify where automation and AI tools can meaningfully accelerate analysis, build proof-of-concepts, and raise the bar on how the division uses data to operate and compete
Push the analytical function forward by improve processes, introduce new methodologies, and help set the standard for how a world-class channels team uses data
Qualifications
4+ years in a business analytics, BI, or commercial data role, ideally inside a B2C SaaS or tech company where data is central to how decisions get made, not just reported
Thrives in complexity: you're energized by ambiguous questions, cross-functional stakeholders, and business problems that don't come with a predefined methodology
Commercially curious: you care about what drives revenue, not just what the data says. You read partnership dynamics, understand incentive structures, and want your work to move business outcomes
AI-forward mindset: You think beyond simply using AI tools and look for ways to integrate them into workflows, automate repetitive work, and create more time for deeper analysis
SQL-native: you're comfortable writing complex queries from scratch and don't rely on tools to do the thinking for you. Experience with BI platforms (Looker, Tableau, or similar) is expected
Clear communicator: you can walk a VP through a nuanced finding in three slides and walk a data engineer through the same problem in a Slack thread. You write and present in English with confidence and precision
Financially fluent: you've built forecasting models and scenario analyses that real stakeholders have acted on, not just as a classroom exercise
Additional Information
Wix makes it possible for anyone to succeed online. Since 2006, we’ve grown to around 4,400 employees in 22 countries, launched over 40 products, and serve over 299 million users and their visitors worldwide. At Wix, we push you to innovate and evolve in non-traditional ways. We operate in collaborative, high-performing teams, building cutting-edge products and leveraging AI to redefine how our users create, manage and grow their dreams online.
Although we’re already industry leaders in web creation and business, our work is nowhere near done. Our goal is to become the main engine of the Internet so we can create a more open web for all.
We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Wix was built around the idea that everyone has the right to be successful, online. This same vision defines us as an employer: creating a work environment where everyone is welcome, and anyone has the right to succeed.

Talent-HR.description:
THE ROLE
We’re looking for a data-driven and business-savvy Analyst to join our growing data team.
In this role, you’ll work closely with our Marketing, Finance, and Sales teams to analyze performance, connect marketing and financial data, and build models that support strategic decisions.
You’ll play a key role in translating data into clear business insights that drive growth, efficiency, and profitability.
Key Responsibilities
Partner with Marketing, Finance, and Sales teams to analyze performance, efficiency, and ROI.
Evaluate UA spend, ROAS, and growth metrics across channels, campaigns, and regions.
Build and maintain dashboards and reports in Cursor, Tableau and Looker to track key business and financial KPIs.
Develop and maintain risk models that help guide company decisions and improve forecasting accuracy.
Conduct cohort and funnel analysis to identify performance trends and growth opportunities.
Collaborate with Data engineering and finance teams to align top level metrics with company financial reporting.
Present actionable insights and recommendations that influence both strategy and operations.
Hiring manager: Uri Adiv, Head of Analytics (Linkedin profile)
Requirements
WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?
5+ years of experience as a Business or Marketing Analyst, preferably in a digital or mobile environment.
Strong technical and analytical skills with hands-on experience in SQL, Tableau, Looker, Cursor (or similar BI tools).
Proven ability to connect marketing performance with financial outcomes and profitability.
Excellent English communication skills written and spoken – for working with cross-functional global teams.
Strong business acumen, attention to detail, ownership and problem-solving mindset.
Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
INTERESTED?
Our Recruitment Process Consists Of The Following Steps
HR interview: ~45 min
Technical Interview with our Business Analytics Team Lead: 60 min.
Take-home challenge: 72 hours
Face 2 Face Technical discussion and presentation of the home assignment with our VP Data and Head of Analytics.
Get in touch at hr@rounds.com. We’d love to hear from you!

Building custom-made reports end to end - from meeting with the client and understanding their needs, to writing the code and setting up the report for ongoing delivery.
Apply your expertise in quantitative analysis and data mining to turn data into insights.
Conduct research and develop tools which will help answer client's’ business. questions by using Similarweb’s raw data sets and algorithms.
Partner with Engineering teams to establish an infrastructure to scale solutions.
Partner with Advisory Services team of Consultants to answer strategic business questions and deliver custom data products seamlessly
This Is The Perfect Job For Someone Who Has
Analyzing Billions of user-based events into meaningful insights for strategic clients.
At least 4 years experience with SQL/pySpark for data analysis - Must
Experience in Python scripting - Must
Excellent verbal and communication skills in English - Must
AWS Infrastructure experience - Big Advantage
Working with clients - Big Advantage.
Proficiency in Online Marketing/Online Services - Advantage
At least 2 years work experience in Online/Tech Company - Advantage
Team player, autodidact, fast learner with excellent analytical, research and business skills.
Demonstrates initiative and a proactive mindset -Must
Experienced in independently managing complex projects from start to finish.
Have a Bachelor's in Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
Master's degree - Big Advantage.
Why You’ll Love Being a Similarwebber
You’ll actually love the product you work with : Our customers aren’t our only raving fans. When we asked our employees why they chose to come work at Similarweb, 99% of them said “the product.” Imagine how exciting your job is when you get to work with the most powerful digital intelligence platform in the world.
You’ll find a home for your big ideas : We encourage an open dialogue and empower employees to bring their ideas to the table. You’ll find the resources you need to take initiative and create meaningful change within the organization.
We offer competitive perks & benefits: We take your well-being seriously, and offer competitive compensation packages to all employees. We also put a strong emphasis on community, with regular team outings and happy hours.
You can grow your career in any direction you choose: Interested in becoming a VP or want to transition into a different department? Whether it’s Career Week, personalized coaching, or our ongoing learning solutions, you’ll find all the tools and opportunities you need to develop your career right here.
Diversity isn’t just a buzzword: People want to work in a place where they can be themselves. We strive to create a workplace that is reflective of the communities we serve, where everyone is empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work. We are committed to inclusivity across race, gender, ethnicity, culture, sexual orientation, age, religion, spirituality, identity and experience. We believe our culture of equality and mutual respect also helps us better understand and serve our customers in a world that is becoming more global, more diverse, and more digital every day.
We will handle your application and information related to your application in accordance with the Applicant Privacy Policy available here.

Talent-HR.title: Big Data Analyst

Talent-HR.description:
About the role We're looking for a sharp and business-oriented Data Analyst to join ONE ZERO and help shape the future of digital banking. In this role, you'll work across product, marketing, finance, and technology teams to identify opportunities, translate complex needs into actionable solutions, and drive impactful initiatives.
This is an opportunity to influence key customer journeys, optimize processes, and support strategic decisions in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
Why join us? At ONE ZERO, we're redefining banking through technology, data, and exceptional customer experience. You'll work with talented people, influence meaningful decisions, and help build products used by thousands of customers.
Your Day-to-Day:
Analyze business processes, customer journeys, and workflows to identify improvement opportunities.
Gather and translate business requirements into clear functional specifications and actionable recommendations.
Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Finance, Technology, and additional stakeholders to drive cross-functional initiatives.
Support the design, implementation, and rollout of new products, features, and internal processes.
Build business cases, define KPIs, and measure impact of initiatives.
Conduct data analysis to identify trends, inefficiencies, and growth opportunities.
Design and build views and aggregation layers in the data warehouse to support reliable, performant, and self-serve analytics.
Develop and maintain semantic layer definitions – including metrics, dimensions, and business logic – to ensure consistent reporting across teams.
Create and optimize aggregations and summary tables to enable fast, scalable analysis across large datasets.
Create documentation, process flows, and presentations for stakeholders and management.
Requirements:
4+ years of experience as a Data Analyst / Business Analyst / Product Analyst or a related role.
Strong analytical thinking with the ability to turn complexity into clarity.
Experience working with cross-functional teams in dynamic environments.
Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities simultaneously.
Strong SQL skills, including the ability to design views, CTEs, and complex aggregations – required.
Hands-on experience building or working with a semantic layer (e.g., dbt metrics, Looker LookML, Cube, or similar) – advantage.
Familiarity with data modeling concepts – star/snowflake schemas, fact and dimension tables, aggregation strategies – advantage.
Experience in fintech, banking, financial services, or regulated environments – significant advantage.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and product development processes.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
You'll thrive here if you:
Enjoy solving complex problems.
Are proactive and take ownership.
Can move between strategic thinking and hands-on execution.
Feel comfortable in fast-changing environments.
Want to shape the future of banking.

Talent-HR.title: Senior Data Analyst

Talent-HR.description:
We're looking for a sharp, hands-on Product Analyst to join us at a pivotal stage of growth, where data drives every product and strategic decision we make.
This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing B2C market leader and shape how we understand our users, funnels, and business performance.
You'll work closely with the company's leadership and Product team, turning complex questions into clear insights, and insights into meaningful product decisions.
Your main focus will be driving the metrics that matter most to us: improving retention, increasing subscription conversion, and scaling our acquisition engines, while building the analytical foundation that enables Mami to grow with confidence.
What You'll Do
Partner directly with company leadership to drive strategic and product decisions through data
Turn business questions into clear analyses, actionable recommendations, and product insights
Bring a strong product mindset to every analysis, focusing on turning insights into clear next steps
Define, monitor, and own the KPIs that matter most across the user journey.
Work closely with cross-functional teams to improve retention, increase subscription conversion, and scale our acquisition funnels
Own and develop Mami's analytics infrastructure across BigQuery, Looker, and Data Studio, from raw data to executive-ready dashboards
Build and integrate AI-powered tools into day-to-day analysis workflows
Requirements
Proven experience as a Product Analyst at at least two B2C companies
Experience working on an e-commerce product - a significant advantage
Hands-on experience with BigQuery, Looker, and Data Studio
Strong SQL skills and the ability to build analytical models from scratch and visualise them
Experience using and integrating AI tools for data analysis workflows (e.g. Claude).
Strong product and business intuition, with the ability to turn data into clear insights and actionable recommendations
Independent, curious, and able to thrive in a small, fast-moving company
Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset
About Mami
Mami is a fast-growing B2C commerce startup built on community, trust, and authentic connection. What started as Maayan Adam's creator-led store has become a leading consumer brand with over 400,000 active users. Now, Mami is evolving into a tech-driven platform empowering creators and communities to build their own personalized shopping experiences, redefining how people connect, create, and shop online.

Responsibilities
Leverage data to understand our products in depth, identify areas of opportunity, and execute projects to drive growth and engagement of Plarium users.
Work closely with the product teams to analyze existing features and ensure a successful implementation of new features.
Use data to fine-tune and balance the game’s economy, providing economy analysis and drive metrics for revenue optimization.
Evaluating and measuring A/B testing results and trends among our players.
Build and maintain reports, dashboards, and metrics to monitor the performance of our products.
Be an expert on industry trends and the competitor landscape to evolve our thinking.
What we expect
2+ years of analytical work experience, preferably for a web or mobile company/e-commerce/ Online Gaming industry.
BA/B.Sc. in Statistics / Math / Engineering / Economics or other quantitative field.
Strong SQL with experience in querying large, complex data sets.
Strong Excel skill.
Proven experience leading data driven projects from definition
Desired
Advanced knowledge in statistical tools and models- advantage
What we offer
Step into our beautiful offices, where comfort meets inspiration.
Enjoy working in a space designed for your well-being, with ergonomic chairs and desks that support your health.
Take advantage of our on-site gym, unwind in the yoga room, or relax in the music room whenever you need a break. Start your mornings with a 5 star breakfast, and keep your energy up throughout the day with freshly made coffee, shakes, and afternoon salads from our in-house barista.
Your health is our priority, which is why we offer full health insurance coverage. We’re also dedicated to your personal and professional growth, offering learning and training programs to help you stay ahead.
Beyond work, our vibrant culture includes happy hours, team events, and plenty of opportunities to connect with your colleagues.
Join us and experience a workplace where your well-being and enjoyment come first.

Talent-HR.description:
About The Role
We're looking for a Data & BI Engineer to build and own our data platform from the ground up. You'll design the architecture, implement scalable data pipelines, and deliver trusted dashboards and analytics that drive business decisions across the company.
The data is everything Rhino runs on: product usage, platform telemetry, customer activity across our deployments, and business systems like CRM, billing, and ERP. It arrives continuously from distributed environments, so the platform is built around pipelines that refresh on a cadence of minutes rather than overnight batches, with layered (bronze/silver/gold) modeling, near real-time views, and online monitoring on top.
You'll report directly to our Head of Engineering Operations and work closely with the Israeli R&D team, BI Manager and US business stakeholders, with a strong voice in technology choices, engineering best practices, and the architecture of a modern, production-grade data platform.
Key Responsibilities
Own the end-to-end implementation of our data platform, from ingestion to reporting.
Build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines from production databases, product telemetry, and SaaS platforms (HubSpot, Rillet, billing, etc.).
Build continuously refreshing pipelines and near real-time data layers, with the monitoring and alerting that keep them trustworthy in production.
Design and evolve the modern data stack, including the data warehouse, transformation, orchestration, and BI layers.
Design, build, and maintain business dashboards and self-service reporting for Sales, Finance, Customer Success, Product, and Leadership.
Apply AI tooling to the data stack, from AI-assisted development to designing agent-based interfaces to our data.
Ensure data quality, reliability, documentation, and monitoring across the platform.
Requirements
4+ years of experience in Data Engineering or BI Engineering.
Strong Python and SQL skills.
Experience with modern data stacks such as dbt, Airflow or Dagster, and data warehouses like Snowflake, BigQuery, or PostgreSQL.
Experience building dashboards using BI tools such as Metabase, Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.
Experience integrating production databases with SaaS platforms (CRM, billing, ERP, marketing analytics, etc.).
Hands-on fluency with modern AI tools in your daily engineering work, and a real interest in where AI is taking data and analytics.
Strong system design skills, high ownership, and the ability to move fast and independently in a startup environment.
Fluent in English and Hebrew.
Nice to Have
Experience building or designing BI / analytics agents, or other agentic workflows on top of data.
Experience with streaming or event-driven data (Kafka, Kinesis, CDC) and real-time monitoring.
Location: Tel Aviv (Hybrid)

comblack.description:
As a BI Developer at LiveU, you will be a key member of the MIS BI team, responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data solutions that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization.
This is a hands-on, end-to-end role that goes beyond traditional frontend BI systems. You will take ownership of projects across the full data lifecycle — from source systems and backend integrations, through ETL/ELT pipelines and data transformations, all the way to dashboards, reporting layers, and user-facing BI applications. We are looking for someone who brings an AI-first mindset and leverages AI tools to improve development efficiency, automation, and data quality.
We are looking for someone who combines strong technical capabilities with a business-oriented mindset. The role involves close collaboration with stakeholders across the company, including gathering requirements, leading discussions, planning projects, translating business needs into technical solutions, and driving initiatives from concept to delivery.
Requirements
2+ years of experience in a BI Developer role
Strong experience with SQL, ETL/ELT processes, data modeling, and Data Warehouse (DWH) methodologies
Strong Python development skills for data workflows
AI-first mindset - actively applies AI tools and thinking to engineering work
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive end-to-end projects independently
Hands-on experience with Snowflake, including pipeline development, data transformation, dbt, GitHub, and cost optimization
Familiarity with BI tools and the BI development ecosystem (e.g. Qlik Sense, Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working alongside BI developers or in a hybrid Data Engineering / BI role
Experience with enterprise systems such as Salesforce or Priority ERP
Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Codex to accelerate development and automation
Skills & Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Team player with excellent interpersonal skills
Ability to manage multiple priorities and parallel workstreams
Strong English communication skills - verbal and written
Motivated to learn new business and technical concepts

comblack.title: Business Intelligence Developer 17621

comblack.description:
The role includes end-to-end responsibility for the organization’s BI solutions, including developing reports and dashboards, working with data sources, building data models, and supporting business processes across operations, finance, supply chain, and sales.
The position is primarily focused on the Qlik Sense environment, alongside a gradual transition to Power BI and Microsoft Fabric, in accordance with the company’s global technological needs. In addition, the role involves working with additional enterprise systems, collaborating with global teams, and partnering with vendors and business stakeholders in Israel and abroad.
Responsibilities:
Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and data models in Qlik Sense.
Write complex SQL queries and work with organizational databases.
Develop and maintain ETL processes and prepare data for analysis and reporting.
Design and build data models while ensuring performance optimization and data quality.
Develop BI solutions according to business needs and global standards.
Work with Qlik Sense alongside the implementation of Power BI and Microsoft Fabric solutions.
Work closely with cross-functional users across the organization to understand business needs, define requirements, and develop BI and data solutions.
Support and implement BI capabilities to enable self-service analytics for business users across the organization.
Work closely with global IS teams, vendors, and integration partners.
Manage user permissions, data security, and implementation of BI governance and work procedures.
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems/ Computer Science/ Industrial Engineering & Management or a related field – mandatory.
3–6 years of experience in BI development and working within data and analytics environments – mandatory.
Significant hands-on experience with Qlik Sense – mandatory.
Advanced SQL experience, including writing complex queries and performance optimization – mandatory.
Experience working with data models, ETL processes, and enterprise databases – mandatory.
High level of English, both written and spoken – mandatory.
Experience working with ERP systems in operational and manufacturing environments – significant advantage.
Experience with Power BI and Microsoft Fabric – advantage.
Familiarity with CRM/ PLM/ ITSM systems – advantage.
Experience in a manufacturing/ industrial environment – significant advantage.
Familiarity with Python or additional scripting languages – advantage.
Microsoft certifications in Data and BI technologies – advantage.
Ability to work independently and lead tasks end-to-end.
Strong analytical thinking and ability to work with multiple interfaces.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to work in a global environment.

comblack.description:
As a Senior BI Analyst at Chargeflow, you will own the company’s BI layer end-to-end—turning business questions into trusted metrics, decision-ready dashboards, and proactive monitoring that helps teams move faster with confidence in the numbers.
You will be responsible for the following key areas:
Metrics & Definitions (Single Source of Truth): Define, standardize, and document KPIs (logic, grain, filters, edge cases) so the company aligns on “what good looks like” and avoids metric drift.
Dashboard Delivery & Storytelling: Build and maintain accurate, performant dashboards that surface trends, risks, and root-cause signals (not just charts).
Data Quality & Observability: Implement data quality checks, anomaly detection, and alerting to catch issues before they impact decision-making.
Semantic Layer for AI/LLM Enablement: Design and maintain a semantic/metrics layer (certified datasets, entities, dimensions, and business definitions) that enables safe, consistent self-serve analytics and unlocks reliable LLM-powered exploration and Q&A on company data.
Stakeholder Partnership: Run a clear BI intake/triage process, manage priorities, and communicate tradeoffs and timelines across Product, Finance, Ops, and Leadership.
Day-to-day activities
Translate stakeholder questions into metric specs and dashboard requirements.
QA metric outputs vs sources; investigate discrepancies and drive fixes.
Build/iterate dashboards and underlying datasets/semantic definitions.
Maintain KPI glossary/metrics dictionary and publish changes with clear comms.
Set up and tune monitoring for critical pipelines/metrics; own follow-ups when alerts fire.
Success indicators
Stakeholders consistently use dashboards as the default source (not spreadsheets / one-off pulls).
Core KPIs have one documented definition, clear ownership, and stable change management.
BI requests become faster and more repeatable due to reusable certified assets.
Data issues are detected proactively, with fewer “surprise” metric regressions.
Requirements:
Qualifications
Minimum 3+ years of relevant BI/analytics experience.
Strong SQL (joins, window functions, CTEs, performance reasoning).
Experience working in at least 2 different companies**/roles** delivering BI outcomes end-to-end.
Proven experience owning BI deliverables end-to-end (metrics + dashboards + documentation).
Strong analytical modeling intuition (facts/dims, grains, joins).
Ability to communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders; can push back with data and tradeoffs.
Ownership mindset and high-quality bar for data reliability.
Nice-to-haves
Familiarity with B2B SaaS/fintech KPIs (e.g., revenue, churn/retention, cohort analysis).
Experience with data observability/testing/alerting practices.
﻿Our Story
Chargeflow is a leading force in fintech innovation, tackling the pervasive issue of chargeback fraud that undermines online businesses. Born from a deep passion for technology and a commitment to excel in eCommerce and fintech, we've developed an AI-driven solution aimed at combating the frustrations of credit card disputes. Our diverse expertise in fintech, eCommerce, and technology positions us as a beacon for merchants facing unjust chargebacks, supported by a unique success-based approach.
Propelled by nearly $20 million funding round led by OpenView Venture Partners and key fintech investors, Chargeflow has embarked on a product-led growth journey. Today, we represent a tight-knit community of passionate individuals and entrepreneurs, united in our mission to revolutionize eCommerce and fight against chargeback fraud, marking us as pioneers in protecting online business revenues.

comblack.title: BI Engineer

comblack.description:
In this role, you will take the analytical lead on our disruptive B2C product and play a key role in driving customer acquisition, marketing performance, and strategic business growth.
The ideal candidate possesses strong analytical and commercial thinking, a deep understanding of large-scale data environments, and the ability to translate complex datasets into actionable business insights. You will partner closely with Data Science, Product, Marketing, and Business stakeholders to influence decision-making, optimize performance, and support scalable growth initiatives.
About the role:
How you’ll make an impact:
Customer & Growth Analytics: Analyze customer acquisition funnels, campaign performance, and behavioral trends to identify growth opportunities and improve business performance.
Strategic Decision Making: Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to provide actionable recommendations and support scalable, data-driven decision-making processes across the organization.
Performance Optimization: Lead deep-dive analyses and A/B testing initiatives to optimize bidding strategies, channel efficiency, and marketing investments.
Data Visualization & Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations that deliver clear and impactful business insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Data Infrastructure Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science and Analytics teams on data modeling, tracking methodologies, and scalable analytics solutions.
Business Impact: Translate complex analytical findings into measurable business outcomes while supporting the company’s performance and revenue goals.
Requirements:
Experience & Technical Skills:
Professional Experience: 5+ years of experience in Data Analysis and interpretation, supporting Marketing, Product, or Business teams in fast-paced environments.
SQL: High proficiency in SQL is required, including working with large and complex datasets.
BI Systems: Strong experience with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Sisense, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
Data Infrastructure: Experience working with modern data warehouse/data lake environments such as Snowflake, Clickhouse, Athena, or BigQuery.
Python: Practical knowledge of Python for data analysis and automation workflows.
Communication: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present analytical insights clearly to both technical and business audiences.
Execution: Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and drive data-informed decisions in a dynamic environment with tight deadlines.
Key Advantages (Nice to Have):
﻿Experience working in B2C or performance marketing environments.
Experience building and maintaining ETL processes.
Experience working closely with Data Science teams on experimentation and optimization initiatives.
Experience leveraging Agentic AI technologies to enhance analytics workflows, automate insights generation, and support data-driven decision-making.
Good to know:
Our amazing offices are located in Rishon LeZion, at the iconic Millennium Tower (Tower 1000)
We work in a hybrid model: 3 days from the office and 2 days from home
About the Company:
About Trivago Innovation Center (formerly Holisto)
We’re part of trivago N.V. , a global B2C travel-tech company headquartered in Düsseldorf, Germany. At trivago Innovation Center, we harness the power of award-winning AI and machine learning technologies to make hotel bookings smarter, more affordable, and perfectly tailored to each traveler.
Fueled by our passion for travel and technology, we’ve spent years researching, developing, and refining solutions that help millions of users save money every single time they book.

Own product analytics across the user journey, including signup, activation, onboarding, adoption, retention, expansion, and churn.

Experience in DWH design and data modeling

comblack.title: Product Data Analyst

comblack.description:
In this role, you will take the analytical lead on our disruptive B2C product and play a key role in driving customer acquisition, marketing performance, and strategic business growth.
The ideal candidate possesses strong analytical and commercial thinking, a deep understanding of large-scale data environments, and the ability to translate complex datasets into actionable business insights. You will partner closely with Data Science, Product, Marketing, and Business stakeholders to influence decision-making, optimize performance, and support scalable growth initiatives.
About the role:
How you’ll make an impact:
Customer & Growth Analytics: Analyze customer acquisition funnels, campaign performance, and behavioral trends to identify growth opportunities and improve business performance.
Strategic Decision Making: Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to provide actionable recommendations and support scalable, data-driven decision-making processes across the organization.
Performance Optimization: Lead deep-dive analyses and A/B testing initiatives to optimize bidding strategies, channel efficiency, and marketing investments.
Data Visualization & Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations that deliver clear and impactful business insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Data Infrastructure Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science and Analytics teams on data modeling, tracking methodologies, and scalable analytics solutions.
Business Impact: Translate complex analytical findings into measurable business outcomes while supporting the company’s performance and revenue goals.
Requirements:
Experience & Technical Skills:
Professional Experience: 3-5 years of experience in Data Analysis and interpretation, supporting Marketing, Product, or Business teams in fast-paced environments.
SQL: High proficiency in SQL is required, including working with large and complex datasets.
BI Systems: Strong experience with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Sisense, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
Data Infrastructure: Experience working with modern data warehouse/data lake environments such as Snowflake, ClickHouse, Athena, or BigQuery.
Python: Practical knowledge of Python for data analysis and automation workflows.
Communication: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present analytical insights clearly to both technical and business audiences.
Execution: Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and drive data-informed decisions in a dynamic environment with tight deadlines.
﻿﻿Key Advantages (Nice to Have):
Experience working in B2C or performance marketing environments.
Experience building and maintaining ETL processes.
Experience working closely with Data Science teams on experimentation and optimization initiatives.
Experience leveraging Agentic AI technologies to enhance analytics workflows, automate insights generation, and support data-driven decision-making.
Good to know:
Our amazing offices are located in Rishon LeZion, at the iconic Millennium Tower (Tower 1000)
We work in a hybrid model: 3 days from the office and 2 days from home
About the Company:
About Trivago Innovation Center (formerly Holisto)
We’re part of trivago N.V. , a global B2C travel-tech company headquartered in Düsseldorf, Germany. At trivago Innovation Center, we harness the power of award-winning AI and machine learning technologies to make hotel bookings smarter, more affordable, and perfectly tailored to each traveler.
Fueled by our passion for travel and technology, we’ve spent years researching, developing, and refining solutions that help millions of users save money every single time they book.
